name: Awa Thiam
shortBio: Senegalese feminist philosopher, anthropologist, and politician whose Speak Out, Black Sisters pioneered Francophone African feminist critique of bodily control, patriarchy, and double oppression.
centralQuestion: How do traditional patriarchal controls and colonial hierarchies converge on the bodies of Black African women, and how do women reclaim testimonial voice?

keyWorks.title: La Parole aux Négresses (Speak Out, Black Sisters)
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking feminist philosophical inquiry centering African women’s lived testimony against FGM, forced marriage, and colonial racism.
